sentences.text: Hello? Hello? Hey, you made it to night two. Nice. I won't keep you long, since things tend to get busier from here on.
Freddy and his friends get more active as the week goes on. It might be a good idea to glance at the cameras while I talk, just to make sure everyone is where they should be.
Interesting fact: Freddy himself doesn't move around much unless it's pitch dark. So if the power runs out... well, then you've got a problem.
Those lights are the only way to see past the doorway. If something's standing there, close the door. If nothing's there, don't waste the power.
One more thing. Check Pirate Cove once in a while. The character in there is... different. He gets restless if nobody's watching him. If he's out of his curtain, shut the left door, fast.
Alright. Good night, and good luck.
